name: gunpowder_store
description: Victorian red-brick gunpowder storeroom (Castle Espie style): small single-storey brick building with brick courses, slate hipped roof, heavy arched studded wooden door in a stone arch with keystone and ring handle, one tiny barred vent, ivy climbing the left corner, grass tufts. Painted sign over the door reads GUNPOWDER STORE (the only text, stays upright, so don't rotate). Anchor bottom-centre, ~700x500.
